Made by hand at a watercolor workshop, San Diego — April 2024

Made by hand during a watercolor workshop in San Diego in April 2024. Soft teal and sage dissolve into one another, a deep blue-green form emerging at the center like a landmass seen through haze — or a thought not quite formed.

The piece evokes stillness and fog over a lake in the early morning, that particular quality of light before the world fully wakes. Watercolor as a medium resists control, and this work leans into that — the edges soft, the color finding its own path across the paper.

The only piece that exists. 1/1.
